warning[ZBX-W0801]: the build has steps that use the network
  while  planning the build
  cause  their output depends on what the network returns, not only on the
         inputs
  cause  steps that use the network: fetch, vendor
  steps  2
  fix    pin what they fetch, or fetch it once outside the build as an input
  more   zbx explain W0801
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/W0801.html
